title: A sugar leaves the gut
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Absorbed glucose enters blood capillaries in intestinal villi and travels toward the liver through the hepatic portal circulation.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: After intestinal cells absorb glucose, which vascular route normally receives it for transport toward the liver? Absorbed glucose enters blood capillaries in intestinal villi and travels toward the liver through the hepatic portal circulation.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
